description: This file defines culture-specific date formatting information for the Tatar (Russia) locale in DateJS library, including date and time patterns, month and day names, regex patterns for parsing, timezone data, and prototype extensions for date manipulation.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets hours, minutes, seconds, and milliseconds to zero for the date object.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the date object to the current date and time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this date to another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if this date equals another date.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day given its name.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month given its name.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a specific month of a year.
